第 n 拍算第 n 项。先逐项相加，再记住上一项。: Tick n computes term n. Add term by term first, then remember the term before.
板每拍算出数列的一项：怎样逐项运算，怎样用上前一项？: The board computes a term a tick: how does it work term by term, and use the term before?
数列里的一个数：第 n 拍，板算出第 n 项。: One number of a sequence: at tick n, the board computes term n.
第 n 拍，每个输入数列给出它的第 n 项。: At tick n, each input sequence gives its n-th term.
第一次往板上放元件: The first part placed on a board
两个输入数列逐项相加。: Add the two input sequences term by term.
板上的电路每一拍从头算一遍，算完什么也不留下。要留下一个值到下一拍，用一对新元件: The board computes afresh every tick and keeps nothing once done. To keep a value for the next tick there is a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.
寄存卡让电路记得上一项。: A register lets a circuit remember the term before.
每一拍交出输入这一项与上一项的和；第一拍的上一项算 0。: Each tick give the input’s term plus the one before; before the first term, take 0.
